zh: 印度尼西亚大学（Universitas Indonesia，简称UI）成立于1849年，位于印度尼西亚雅加达省德波市，是印度尼西亚历史最悠久的现代高等教育机构之一，也是印尼最具代表性的综合性大学，环太平洋大学联盟成员。在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第189位，较上年提升17位，成为印尼唯一进入全球前200名的高校。学校设有十七大院系，汇聚了三点六万印尼精英学子，其中医学、法学、工程更是王牌中的王牌。
en: The University of Indonesia (UI), founded in 1849, is located in Depok, Jakarta Province, Indonesia. It is one of the oldest modern higher education institutions in Indonesia, a representative comprehensive university, and a member of the Association of Pacific Rim Universities. Ranked 189th in the QS World University Rankings 2026, rising 17 places from the previous year, it is Indonesia's only university in the global top 200. The university has 17 faculties with 36,000 outstanding Indonesian students, with medicine, law, and engineering as its strongest programs.
